subject: Wholesale rate realignment & operations fit for CloudCycle
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@cloudcycle.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudcycle.com
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Wholesale pricing alignment request

Hi Jonas,

Following up after our vendor review last week. Our procurement team has received a competing wholesale proposal from LumaServe that would lower our effective per-token cost by ~22% for sustained throughput. CloudCycle is evaluating a vendor realignment in Q1 and we need to understand whether Redwood can provide a comparable rate schedule or an alternative packaging that meets our cost+ops constraints.

Key asks:
- Can you provide a wholesale rate table for 6/12/24 month committed volumes (tokens/month)?
- Any pilot credits or staged discounts you can offer for a phased migration (90–180 days)?
- Confirmation on SLA uplift and whether we can isolate traffic to a dedicated pool to meet our latency targets.

I attached the RFP excerpt with our usage profile and the competing offer. We would like a written offer by EOD Friday so procurement can present to execs.

Thanks,

Alicia Moreno
Sr. Procurement Manager
CloudCycle Inc.
Attachment: CloudCycle_RFP_2026-11.pdf (pdf, 412KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@cloudcycle.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Wholesale pricing alignment request

Hi Alicia — thanks for the detail and the RFP.

We can absolutely pull together a competitive wholesale schedule. To make sure we align the economics to your workload, can you confirm:
- % of tokens that are generation vs embeddings (ballpark)?
- Peak concurrent requests and target p99 latency (ms)?

I'll loop in Laura (commercial) and Connor (solutions) to draft both a rate sheet and a recommended packaging that minimizes migration risk.

Can we book a 30-min slot Thursday morning to review?

Best,
Jonas

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Wholesale pricing alignment request (internal)

Laura / Connor — forwarding Alicia's RFP. Quick internal notes (do not forward):

Context: CloudCycle is a 2.3B ARR payments platform; they have seasonal spikes and strict latency SLAs. LumaServe's proposal leans on aggressive prepay + volume tiers; we should avoid an unsustainable unit rate.

Proposed structures to evaluate:
1) Staged commitment: 6mo pilot at -15% off public wholesale, convert to 12mo at -20% if ramp metrics met (KPI: token throughput, pct cache hit)
2) Dedicated pool add-on: +10% seat to guarantee p99 latency and KVS isolation (helps ops claims)
3) Usage buffer credits: 10% on top of committed volume for first 90 days to smooth onboarding overages

I've attached an initial spreadsheet with modeled unit economics for each option.

Attachments: pricing_models_v2.xlsx

Thoughts: Laura — commercial flexibility; Connor — ops/latency feasibility for dedicated pool?

—Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@cloudcycle.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Wholesale rate realignment & operations fit for CloudCycle

Alicia — thanks for the call today. Per our discussion, attached is a concise offer that aligns to the competitive economics while protecting operational reliability.

Summary of offer (high level):
- Pilot: 6-month staged pilot with a 15% wholesale discount off our standard wholesale rate, includes 10% onboarding credits for the first 90 days.
- Conversion: If the pilot KPIs are met (3-week ramp metric + latency <200ms p99), convert to a 12-month committed volume at 20% off wholesale.
- Dedicated Pool: Optional dedicated pool add-on (one-time $Xk provisioning + 10% premium on unit rates) to meet isolation and latency SLAs.

Attachments: CloudCycle_Staged_Discount_Term_Sheet.pdf
DocuSign link for the pilot SOW: https://docusign.net/ClD-CLD-2026-042

Next steps:
1) Review the term sheet and comment by EOD Friday.
2) If okay, sign the pilot SOW and we will provision the dedicated pool within 10 business days.
